completeness.why: All five provider handlers now only compute their own bank key, institution and account fields and delegate upgrade-or-insert, transfer payee, initial sync, handleSyncResponse and the sync event to linkBankSyncAccount; the GoCardless mask/official name, Pluggy file id and Akahu tables are passed as explicit arguments, and EnableBanking's unreachable id check disappears with the shared typed id.

interface.why: Parameters map to the real variations (accountSyncSource, providerBankId, officialName, optional mask, optional syncFileId, required syncEventTables), with the preserved inconsistencies visible at each call site and no speculative options; only the institution null-name comment was lost.

disguised_duplication.where: the copies are removed; the remaining per-site institution/orgDomain??orgId expressions are the provider-specific bank lookup the request leaves per provider
